rows.claim: No version of the code can pass both of these and also do what you asked.
rows.evidence: The test files printed in T0B3 show the conflict. test_get_refreshes and test_reads_do_not_refresh run identical steps but assert opposite results for 'a'. test_expired and test_entries_never_expire_on_read run identical steps (put, clock to 10.0, get) but one expects None and the other 'v'. Deterministic code cannot satisfy both pairs while also fixing the two bugs. The pytest run in T0B7 shows exactly these two tests failing.
